rationale: Rounds 5-9 tile size sweep: TILE_KV=16→0.566, 32→0.491, 48→0.473(best), 64→0.574. WMMA ceiling ~0.47ms. 连续3轮改善<5%进入平台期: 按策略需换完全不同的技术原理。选项A: 接受0.473ms作为WMMA上限，记录WGMMA发现。选项B: 尝试PTX级别的mma.sync.aligned.m16n8k16 (WMMA的底层PTX替代，可能更紧凑的寄存器layout)。选项C: 尝试TILE_Q=128 (更大Q tile)配合TILE_KV=48减少barrier次数。实际上平台期处理原则建议换完全不同的方向: 本轮尝试完全不同的attention计算结构——使用2-pass approach (non-flash): (1) compute full S=QK^T/scale per Q-tile (no online softmax), (2) softmax, (3) O=P*V. 这样避开online-softmax的register压力，可以用更aggressive的WMMA/WGMMA配置。注意: 需要足够的smem存S矩阵: S[TILE_Q][TILE_KV] BF16, 对TILE_Q=64,TILE_KV=64: 64*64*2=8KB, 总smem可控。

implementation_spec.approach: 2-pass attention: pass1 compute S=QK^T (can use WMMA qk_acc[4] since it doesn't persist across KV iterations), pass2 apply softmax+AV simultaneously using persistent S
implementation_spec.key_difference: No online softmax running average m/l across iterations. Instead: (1) per-block: compute S=QK^T for all KV tiles accumulating max in smem, then (2) normalize and compute O=P*V in second pass. BUT this requires 2 passes over KV data = 2x bandwidth. So this is likely SLOWER not faster.
implementation_spec.honest_assessment: 2-pass will be slower due to 2x KV memory traffic. Better alternative: try WMMA TILE_KV=48 with __launch_bounds__(128,5) to see if that pushes registers lower.
implementation_spec.actual_plan: Try __launch_bounds__(128,5) with TILE_KV=48 to force compiler to target 5 blocks/SM (65536/(128*5)=102 reg cap ≈ current 100). May give slight improvement through better compiler code gen.
implementation_spec.target_milestone: M3 if possible, else accept 0.473ms plateau
